published_ranges._notes: 3DXTech TDS Rev 3.0 (German-language copy hosted by Conrad, SKU NYL3010500BK0, 'CarbonX CF PA6'). TDS gives specimen print conditions only, no recommended range: 275C nozzle, 80C bed, 0.4mm nozzle. Older Gen2 TDS Rev 2.1 (semi-aromatic PA copolymer) listed 255-275 nozzle / 90-100 bed / 50-80 mm/s and HDT 147, density 1.17 - different generation, not used in fields. Surface resistance >10^9 ohm/sq. Filament diameter not printed on the cited TDS (removed in source check).
